notes.title: Update 2.01 Out Now!
notes.notes:
The massively expanded [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/748330/Super_Mega_Space_Blaster_Special_Turbo/]'Turbo Edition' - Super Mega Space Blaster Special Turbo[/url] has just launched on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PS4, and Xbox One bringing more ships, upgrades, more modes, more challenges and more space blasting action to the space blaster series. Now that the initial release of the 'Turbo Edition' is over I've had time to fix some issues that players have been asking for. Here is a list of fixes in update 2.01.

[b]Additions:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Added support for more retro gamepads.
[/olist]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*]When changing the volume slider for 'Voice' in the pause menu the voice no longer says 'Hello' a ridiculous number of times per second.
[*]The leaderboard button images now display the correct button/key depending on the control method and type of gamepad.
[*]The progress percentage is now correctly calculated.
[*]The Cursor is now the correct size when using keyboard and mouse controls in Linux.
[*]Completed challenge messages now display in the game-over screen and on loading screens.
[*]Corrected a number of typo's.
[/olist] 

If you have any questions, problems, or feedback about the game just give us a shout. We’d love to hear what you think of the game and will do our best to respond as quickly as possible, providing support if necessary. Also let us know if you had fun playing the game because that really does make our day!

The 'Turbo Edition' has been getting some great reviews check them out in this accolades trailer:

[previewyoutube=Wwbi4s-ijH8;full][/previewyoutube]

All the best and happy blastingːsteamhappyː,

Ste (BKD)

notes.title: Some Awesome Reviews & Version 1.11 Out Now!

[*] Changed splash screen.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where score was wrongly calculated in 'To The Death' mode.
[*] Fixed issue where 'buy ship' button would always show PlayStation button image. Now it shows correct image for used controller or keyboard/mouse.
[*] Fixed issue where when 'quit? yes/no' dialog box was on screen no button could be selected meaning the player would have to press the back button to go back to the game menu and then quit again.
[*] Fixed issue where controller vibration would not work correctly.
[*] Fixed issue where item crates sometimes showed the wrong image for their contents.
[*] Fixed issue where player 2's third space blaster's (Lunavi) jet trail was set at a distance from the ship's body.

notes.title: Loads of Great Press in Launch Week Plus Update 1.08 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35106452/a6bf5f54cadd0fab6b14f820df1623ab16879ca8.png[/img]

Launch week went really well. We got loads of great feedback from players and some very positive reviews and articles from the game press. [url=https://bareknuckledev.com/games/supermegaspaceblasterspecial/super-mega-media/]Check out our article[/url] about the media attention Super Mega Space Blaster Special has been getting.

We've also released 8 small updates since launch bringing the game's version number up to 1.08. These updates responsed to player feedback, addressed a few issues and added a feature. Read on below to find out what was included in these updates.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Left stick (for dual stick controllers) sensitivity calibration slider added to the controls menu.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the new logo to the game.
[*] Added achievement check to loading of start menu screen. If something goes wrong during gameplay and an achievement does not register it will when you next go to the start menu.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with some character voices saying the wrong phrase when collecting certain power-ups.
[*] Added sound FXs to the opening and closing of the Story and Leaderboards screens.
[*] Fixed bug where one challenge (challenge 16) was unachievable. 
[*] Fixed wrongly labelled achievements.
[*] Fixed some language issues.
[/list]

Give us a shout anytime in the SMSBSp Steam community or in our [url=https://discord.gg/J4ynrFD]Discord[/url] with ideas for future updates or just to chat. Thanks again to everyone for playing and hope you are enjoying the game.

Happy blasting ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Improvements to the Big-Boss Beta Update 0.0.6
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35106452/56c4d52b28ab582172dba743751a851823c68c6f.jpg[/img]

Beta version 0.0.6 of Super Mega Space Blaster Special is now live and ready to play. It includes improvements to the boss (in survival mode) and a few fixes.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Boss now drops more coins and items.
[*] Boss now has a warning indicator when off screen.
[*] Boss now has a second attack phase to make it more challenging.
[*] Boss now drops ammo if the player runs out during the boss battle.
[*] Mouse click now starts game from the loading/ready screen.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mine drop rate has been decreased to prevent the player's ammo running out.
[*] Various typos were corrected.
[/list]

Thanks again to all the testers and hope you enjoy the new build.

Happy blasting ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: First Beta Version of SM Space Blaster Sp - Out Now
notes.notes:
We've just launched the first beta version of Super Mega Space Blaster Special. 
Thanks to everyone taking part. The game already has a lot of features from 10 ships to unlock, to various game and multiplayer mode, to challenges and achievements. We want to make the game as much fun to play as possible so let us know of any ways you want it to be improved and obviously tell us of any problems so we can fix them.

Thanks again and happy testing :)
